class.name: JRPGChangeHPCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: raises or lowers the HP of an actor or the party.
class.description: Changes the actors' HP by the amount, within 0 and their max HP. A decrease that would bring HP to 0 or below knocks the actor out only with [member allow_death]; otherwise HP stops at 1. Knocked-out actors are left as they are: [JRPGChangeStateCommand] or [JRPGRecoverAllCommand] revive them. Authority: server.

members.member: A decrease may knock actors out (HP 0).
